title: VALUE DRIFTS: TRACING VALUE ALIGNMENT DUR-ING LLM POST-TRAINING

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting model responses to value-laden questions on topics such as abortion, immigration, elections, climate change, and the death penalty from the V-PRISM dataset, and using GPT-4o to classify the stance (support, neutral, oppose) to measure value drifts during post-training.

Evaluating the model's generated stances on value-probing questions regarding gender equality and LGBTQ+ identity, tracking how the distribution of support, neutral, or oppose responses changes across training checkpoints.

Classifying the stance of model responses to questions specifically focused on race and racism, measuring the drift magnitude and drift time of these values during supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization.
Using an LLM evaluator to categorize the model's explicitly generated stances on questions concerning religion and spirituality beliefs into support, neutral, or oppose categories.

Analyzing model responses to prompts concerning family and relationship values, economic and social policies, and work-life attitudes to determine the latent social values embedded in the model during training.
